progress_summary: The shipped v1.9 release satisfies the repository QA strategy in .opchain/qa.yaml. The clean pre-merge ledger passed all 11 mapped workflow gates with no warning or skip: 43 Vitest files and 579 tests, Worker build, Astro check/build, Playwright e2e, and Lighthouse budgets. Staging and production live acceptance then passed at exact runtime SHA 244bf13e9b4e0abbca5a3d8cb8dfdb811d0b1248, including MCP session security, limits, Origin policy, cross-environment isolation, health, content, and the 7/7 production post-deploy sequence.

progress_table.label: MCP, retention, release, and hardening contracts

key_decisions: Coverage enforcement remains governed by .opchain/qa.yaml; this release does not silently strengthen optional budgets.
A transient build failure does not become a pass by dismissal: isolated and complete clean reruns were both required and passed.
Live HTTP controls remain post-deploy acceptance checks and are not misrepresented as pre-deploy proof.
